[[File:Gwori_Revolutionary_Industries.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Gwori shipyards.]]
The '''Gwori shipyards''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gwori]], affiliated with [[Gwori Revolutionary Industries/Legends|Gwori Revolutionary Industries]]. It made [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] frigates during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the shipyard was infiltrated by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces on a [[Battle of Gwori|mission]] to destroy it. The mission marked one of the first deployments of the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]].

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the shipyards was seized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in order to produce exclusively [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
